name: Eventin Addon for Elementor
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Eventin Addon for Elementor lets you build Eventin single-event templates with Elementor. Eventin’s template builder already supports Gutenberg; this addon brings the same field-level components to Elementor, so you can lay out an event page widget by widget.

Every widget renders through Eventin’s own template code, so an Elementor-built event page matches a Gutenberg-built one exactly – same markup, same styles, no separate stylesheet to keep in sync.

What this addon adds

Eventin itself already ships Elementor widgets for event listings – Events, Speakers, Schedule, Event Calendar, Advanced Search and so on. This addon does not duplicate those. It adds the single-event widgets that were missing, for composing the event page itself.

Available Widgets

Find them in Elementor under the Eventin Single Event category.

Event content
Event Title, Event Banner, Event Logo, Event Description, Event Date & Time, Event Venue, Event Category, Event Tags, Event Social Share

People
Event Speakers, Event Organiser, Event Attendees

Details
Event Schedule, Event FAQ, Event Countdown, Add to Calendar, Recurring Event, Related Events, Zoom Meeting

Tickets
Buy Ticket, Event RSVP

Multiple design styles

Eight widgets ship several pre-built layouts, matching the styles Eventin already provides: Event Venue, Event Speakers and Event Schedule offer five each; Event Date & Time, Event Organiser and Related Events offer three; Event FAQ and Event Attendees offer two.

Starter templates

In Eventin > Template Builder, switch the builder to Elementor and click New Template. The new template opens in Elementor, and a starter chooser offers four ready-made single-event layouts. Three mirror Eventin’s Gutenberg starters; the fourth, Complete Event Page, places every widget on one page as a reference layout you can strip back. Choosing one fills the canvas with that layout, so it is a starting point rather than a fixed design. Close the chooser to start from a blank canvas; reopen it from the Eventin icon beside Elementor’s add-section buttons.

Use Preview Event in the editor’s top bar to preview a template against one of your own events instead of Eventin’s demo event. Nothing on the live site changes.

The free version of Eventin allows one template; Eventin enforces that limit when New Template is clicked.

Known limitations

  • Event Category, Event Tags, Event Logo and Add to Calendar can each be used once per page. Eventin loads their templates a single time per request, so a second copy renders empty. The same applies in the block editor.
  • Responsive styling uses Eventin’s breakpoints (768px tablet, 480px mobile) rather than Elementor’s configurable breakpoints.
  • These widgets read the current event, so they belong in an Eventin template or on a single event page. Placed elsewhere they show a notice in the editor.
  • Event RSVP renders only when the event has RSVP enabled. Event Logo renders only when the event has a logo. Event Social Share renders only when the event has social links.
  • Event Banner has no style selector: Eventin whitelists a second banner style but ships only a placeholder file for it.

Requirements

  • Eventin – Core event management plugin (Free)
  • Elementor – Page builder (Free)
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Perfect For

  • Conference organizers
  • Event management companies
  • Educational institutions
  • Training providers
  • Meetup organizers
  • Community event managers
  • Festival coordinators
  • Webinar hosts

About Eventin

Eventin is a complete event management solution for WordPress. With Eventin, you can:
* Create and manage unlimited events
* Sell event tickets with WooCommerce
* Manage attendees and registrations
* Create event schedules and sessions
* Showcase speakers
* Zoom integration for virtual events
* And much more!

Credits

This plugin is developed and maintained by Arraytics.

Special thanks to:
* The Eventin team for the amazing event management plugin
* The Elementor team for the powerful page builder
* The WordPress community for continuous support
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Eventin Elementor Addon”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Make sure Eventin and Elementor plugins are installed and activated
  2. Edit any page with Elementor
  3. Drag and drop widgets to build your event pages
  4. Customize the design using Elementor’s styling options
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Eventin?

No, this plugin requires Eventin to be installed and activated. It extends Eventin’s functionality by adding Elementor widgets.

Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No, this plugin requires Elementor page builder to be installed and activated.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 ( October 27, 2026 )

New: 21 single-event widgets for building event pages in Elementor
New: Event pages built in Elementor look the same as those built in the block editor
New: Multiple design styles for eight widgets
New: Choose which event a widget shows
New: Ready-made starter templates in the Elementor editor
New: Preview a template with one of your own events
New: Helpful editor notices when a widget can’t show an event
Fix: Templates built in Elementor now always open in Elementor
Removed: Duplicate listing widgets (Events, Schedule, Speakers, Schedule List, Events Tab, Advanced Search, Upcoming Event Tab, Event Calendar, Event Meta Info). Eventin provides these itself, so existing pages keep working.
Security: Visitors never see a draft event picked while building a template

1.0.0 ( January 01, 2026 )

New: Initial release
